item.title: OverCutterHelper 2.9.26
item.description: The camera is now checked by picture (and the tap file's own A/B letter), not just the tap's name: a B-camera tap named as A gets B, and the report says so. A tap named with the wrong slate or take is matched by its sound and listed in the Summary. New Picture check button on the results: each take's tap beside the high-res used.

item.title: OverCutterHelper 2.9.25
item.description: Closing the window during an overcut now puts it in the menu bar (OCH and the percentage): click it to see the progress or stop it. It finishes in the background and tells you when the bin is ready.

item.title: OverCutterHelper 2.9.24
item.description: Send logs now sends the zip to Pete itself, attached, with a note of what happened - no email app needed. If it can't, the email opens and Finder comes to the front with the zip ready to drag on. Closing the window during an overcut no longer stops it: it finishes in the background and tells you. Crashes are now recorded in the logs.

item.title: OverCutterHelper 2.9.23
item.description: Dragging a licence file onto the window works again.

item.title: OverCutterHelper 2.9.22
item.description: Settings (the ⚙ button) now fill the window, with tabs down the side so you see one thing at a time, and scroll bars you can see.

item.title: OverCutterHelper 2.9.21
item.description: The timelines to overcut have their own wide list under the cards: bigger rows, wide enough for long timeline names, a box to find a timeline by name, Tick all / Untick all, and smooth scrolling.

item.title: OverCutterHelper 2.9.20
item.description: The timelines to overcut now have their own wide list under the cards: bigger rows, two or three columns, a box to find a timeline by name, Tick all / Untick all, and it scrolls smoothly (it no longer jumps while you scroll).

item.title: OverCutterHelper 2.9.19
item.description: A little flourish when an overcut finishes (the wallet closes with a stitched tick), a stitched progress bar, and a tally: each result says how many tap clips were swapped and roughly how much time that saved, with a running total in the ⚙ panel.

item.title: OverCutterHelper 2.9.18
item.description: Send logs is easier: pick Gmail, Outlook, the Mail app or just the zip. Gmail and Outlook open in your browser with the email filled in, so nothing needs setting up on the Mac. Your choice is remembered for the Send logs buttons on error messages.

item.title: OverCutterHelper 2.9.17
item.description: The opening wallet shows OVER / CUTTER / HELPER on three lines, bigger.
